hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}/.agents/skills/bento-setup/scripts/push_gate.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then python3 "$f"; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 0 ] || [ $rc -eq 2 ]; then exit $rc; fi; echo "bento: pre-PR review gate failed (exit $rc), blocking; fix it or rerun bento-setup" >&2; exit 2; else echo "bento: pre-PR review gate missing at $f; rerun bento-setup" >&2; exit 1; fi
